about.description: GEELY is a single-stock perpetual listed on Gate, tracking Geely Automobile Holdings Limited, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
